title: IRGC Public Relations Announces Downing of U.S. Army's "Lucas" Suicide Drone in Sirik region
text:
IRGC Public Relations Announces Downing of U.S. Army's "Lucas" Suicide Drone in Sirik region"

"The Public Relations Department of IRGC has announced the downing of a "Lucas" suicide drone belonging to the U.S. military, which subsequently crashed on the waters of the Persian Gulf. The drone was intercepted by the IRGC's modern advanced defense system, operating under the control of the country's integrated air defense network in the Sirik region, Hormozgan province."

"**This video dates back to April**
